# telnyx_ai_gateway_token_key (Resource)

A token key of the AI gateway, which applications call LLMs with under the limits of its token group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "telnyx_ai_gateway_token_group" "example" {
  name            = "internal-tools"
  allowed_models  = ["openai/gpt-4o-mini"]
  max_budget      = 100
  budget_duration = "30d"
  rpm_limit       = 60
}

resource "telnyx_ai_gateway_token_key" "example" {
  name           = "ci"
  token_group_id = telnyx_ai_gateway_token_group.example.id
}

# The key's token is only returned when it is created.
output "gateway_token" {
  value     = telnyx_ai_gateway_token_key.example.token
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `token_group_id` (String)

### Optional

- `allowed_models` (Set of String)
- `blocked` (Boolean)
- `budget_duration` (String) One of `1d`, `30d`, `7d`.
- `expires_at` (String)
- `max_budget` (Number) Stored key limit; set to the maximum when the key was written without one (on a blocked key, null is kept until the key is unblocked).
- `max_parallel_requests` (Number) Optional maximum concurrent reserved/dispatched cache misses across replicas. Null means no concurrency cap. Cache hits do not consume slots; unknown usage retains its budget hold without a slot.
- `required_end_user_id` (Boolean) Require a nonempty caller-asserted end-user ID; not proof of identity.
- `rpm_limit` (Number) Stored key limit; set to the maximum when the key was written without one (on a blocked key, null is kept until the key is unblocked).
- `token_user_id` (String)
- `tpm_limit` (Number) Stored key limit; set to the maximum when the key was written without one (on a blocked key, null is kept until the key is unblocked).

### Read-Only

- `budget_started_at` (String)
- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The object's id.
- `provisioning` (String) Provisioning state of the key's current policy. `pending`: retry readiness with bounded backoff (treat `unknown` the same). `inactive` and `unsupported` are terminal until the key, group, user or catalog changes. `unavailable` means provisioning is stuck and is retried slowly; surface it. Absent while the gateway runs in compatibility mode.
- `record_type` (String) A JSON document; use `jsondecode()` to read it.
- `reserved_spend` (Number) USD, decimal precision at most 6 places; parse exactly to integer micro-USD, never binary float accounting.
- `resets_at` (String)
- `spend` (Number) USD, decimal precision at most 6 places; parse exactly to integer micro-USD, never binary float accounting.
- `token` (String, Sensitive)
- `updated_at` (String)
- `version` (Number)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import telnyx_ai_gateway_token_key.example <id>
```
